list_floor: Inclusive 10% on either endpoint before rounding
parent_sequences: Not embedded; cross-reference original labels and native IDs
other_fields: Record identities, sequence, metadata and every qualifying pair are retained unchanged
listed_count: Count the entries in the paired list; completeness counts belong in build audit metadata

percentage_format.rounding: half-up from two-decimal percentage serialization; selection uses unrounded counts

label_components: Existing gene (or organism fallback), accession, assay ID in that order; missing components omitted; original values retained
escaping: Escape literal backslash, semicolon, at sign and pipe within each label component; structural pipes and @ are unescaped
public_filenames: Single underscore joins; human_current is huscan and virscan_exposome_current is virscan_exposome
csv_encoding: UTF-8 with BOM; ASCII-only column headings
pair_regions_policy: Same qualifying records and order as the percentage list; independently merged residue unions, not alignment correspondences
short_sequences: Records shorter than nine residues remain present with their length and empty pair lists
